title: God Protocol Active
description: A cyberpunk fantasy scene featuring three figures standing in a misty, neon-lit futuristic city with flying vehicles and holographic signs. In the center, an Asian woman with black horns wears a purple and black armored bodysuit with glowing circuits while holding a glowing katana. To her left stands a silver-haired elf in ornate silver armor holding a small glowing orb, and to her right is a blue demonic male with large horns and glowing blue patterns.
prompt: A cinematic cyberpunk fantasy scene set in a foggy futuristic city with towering neon buildings and flying vehicles. In the foreground, a beautiful Asian woman with black horns and long black hair wears a form-fitting purple and black technological armor with glowing circuits, holding a glowing katana. To her left is a silver-haired female elf in ornate silver armor holding a small glowing orb. To her right stands a muscular blue demon with large curved horns and glowing blue patterns across his body. A sign above reads 'GOD PROTOCOL ACTIVE' and another sign shows Japanese text. Atmospheric mist and dramatic lighting.
